       AND LOCM.PLNG_LANGCODE = '@Session(languageCode)'

       AND LOC.plot_location_type = plot.plot_location_type

    ON plot.porg_orgacode = plotm.porg_orgacode
       AND plot.plot_location_type = plotm.plot_location_type
       AND plotm.plng_langcode = '@Session(languageCode)'
